messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Deploy finished for model-updates/v2.14 -> prod (artifact: model:v2.14-hash=a1b2c3)
sophie: seeing a jump in errors from canaries, looks like tokenization failures on a subset of hosts
deploy-bot: canary summary: 4/10 hosts failing parse; sample failure payloads attached to the release log
ryan_oncall: I'm oncall — paging in. Can someone confirm customer impact?
maria: quick check: some requests returning 5xx, ramping at ~300 req/min in the last 2m. Not wide yet but growing
sophie: stack traces point to tokenizer mismatch: weights/asset bundle appear to be from tokenizer schema v1.2 but runtime expects v1.3
anne_eng: that matches an oddity I saw in CI metadata: release manifest hash for tokenizer didn't match the uploaded weightset checksum. Possibly an earlier step overwrote the bundle.
sophie: snippet from prod logs:
```
2026-03-15T14:12:03Z ERROR tokenizer: unknown token 0xff at pos 12
release-manifest.checksum.expected=a1b2c3
release-manifest.checksum.actual=deadbeef
```
ryan_oncall: we need a mitigation path. Maria, can you revert routing to the previous model version or enable livekill?
maria: starting rollback: routing pinned to model:v2.13-hash=0f0f0f via rollout service API now. If that stalls we flip the livekill flag.
ops-bot: rollout request accepted (id=rollout-369001), targeting 100% traffic over 60s.
sophie: canaries trending back down but a few hosts still erroring with tokenizer decode errors. Might be sticky connections.
maria: initiating `featureflag.livekill.model-routing=true` to force fallback to serve-v1.3 compatible variants. Propagating to edge.
ops-bot: featureflag.livekill.model-routing=true applied to prod (scope: all).
prod-support: customer-alert draft: "We are investigating elevated errors in text generation; mitigation in progress. We'll follow up within 30 minutes." Should we send?
ryan_oncall: hold on alerts until we confirm rollback success. Post an update to affected customers after we see stable metrics for 5m.
anne_eng: digging into deployment artifacts: build pipeline shows `upload-weights` step returned 200 but artifact storage later reported a slow window where a temp file (tokenizer) may have been truncated. Putting a block in CI to verify checksums post-publish.
sophie: current numbers: 5xxs peaked at ~1200 reqs in last 5m, 90% from one region (us-west-2). Premium customers impacted: we see traces from 3 tenant IDs.
maria: rollback to v2.13 reached 100% in 90s; latency and error rates dropping on dashboards.
ryan_oncall: good — keep monitoring. Reopen if errors > baseline+200 for 3m.
ops-bot: in-flight requests still failing will continue until connections drain (~2m).
prod-support: posting initial customer notice now: "Issue detected and rollback initiated; mitigation in progress. Expect another update in 30 minutes."
sophie: creating an internal incident ticket: INC-2026-369001; assigning anne_eng as owner for root cause and fix for artifact publish.
anne_eng: immediate action items: 1) revert pipeline to block inconsistent uploads, 2) add post-publish checksum verification step, 3) add manifest/hash validation at deploy time.
maria: after rollback observed ~98% reduction in errors within 4m. Still monitoring 2 hosts that show tokenization errors (likely sticky old process) — I'll force restart those hosts.
ryan_oncall: please capture command used for restart and paste here.
maria: command used: `k8s rollout restart deployment/model-serving --selector=host=canary-us-west-2`
sophie: confirmed restarts cleared remaining errors; metrics look stable for 10m now.
prod-support: sending customer follow-up: "Service restored; root-cause investigation underway; we'll provide a postmortem with timeline and mitigation steps."
anne_eng: tagging follow-up PR for CI: `fix/verify-artifact-checksum` and will schedule a canary run to validate.
ryan_oncall: closing pager for now. Thanks team.
prod-support: incident archived pending postmortem (owner=anne_eng).
maria: note for postmortem: we must add an automated rollback-on-checksum-fail to the release pipeline to prevent partial publishes.
anne_eng: will lead the postmortem and link logs, release manifests, and CI traces to INC-2026-369001. ETA for draft: EOD tomorrow.
